data.long_meaning: One who announces, calls to prayer, or preaches. The name Saabih carries the meaning “Announcer, Preacher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Saabih usually hope their child will grow to embody announcer, preacher and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Saabih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Announcer, Preacher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saabih total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
